title: terrain.support_beam_destroyed
description: M14E support-beam destruction event. Emitted when a placed `support_beam` is demolished (player demolish-tool, blast, or cumulative integrity damage). Unlocks the integrity-field ±8 px around the beam and queues `compute_integrity_pass` on the affected chunk within ≤5 ticks (so a `terrain.structural_integrity_low` may fire on the same chain).

world_pos.description: World-space position of the destroyed beam as [x, y] (pixels).

chunk_id.description: Chunk coordinate the destruction landed in.

cause.description: Reason the beam was destroyed: 'demolish' (player tool), 'blast' (explosive), 'cascade' (cave-in propagation), 'reactor_breach' (M9 explosion).

actor_id.description: Optional actor id of the demolisher (when cause == 'demolish').

footprint_half_px.description: Half-extent (pixels) of the beam footprint the destruction cleared. Default 8.
